p.b: An Act to amend certain provisions of the
relating to pathology services, and for related purposes

content.p: 1. (1) This Act may be cited as the Health Insurance (Pathology Services) Amendment Act 1991.
(2) In this Act, “Principal Act” means the Health Insurance Act 19731.
2. (1) Subject to subsection (2), this Act commences on the day on which it receives the Royal Assent.
(2) Each of the provisions of subsections 4 (1) and 5 (1) is taken to have commenced on the day, or at the time, shown by the note in italics at the foot of that provision.
3. Unless the contrary intention appears, a word or expression:

item.p: defined in the Principal Act for the purposes of that Act; and
used in this Act;

content.p: has in this Act the same meaning as it has in the Principal Act.
4. (1) Schedule 1 to the Principal Act is amended:
(a) by inserting in each of items 1345 and 1346 in the table of medical services “(other than a microbiological or tissue antigen or antibody)” after “substance”;
(b) by adding at the end of the rules for the interpretation of the table of medical services the following rules:
“A.1. If a particular service falls within both:

item.p: the description of service in an item that describes the service in general terms; and
the description of service in an item that describes the service in specific terms;

content.p: only the item that describes the service in specific terms is taken to relate to the service.

item.p: a particular service falls within the description of service in 2 or more items; and
rule A.1 does not apply;

content.p: the item that specifies the lower or lowest fee is taken to be the item that relates to the service.”;
(c) by inserting each of the following items in its appropriate numerical position in the table of medical services:

tr.td: Each test referred to in the above item in excess of one (SP)
Each test referred to in the above item in excess of one (OP)

content.p: after 1 January 1980 and before 1 August 1986.

item.p: after an item was inserted in the table of medical services in Schedule 1 to the Principal Act by a paragraph of subsection (1); and
before that item was omitted by another paragraph of that subsection;

content.p: another table of medical services was prescribed for the purposes of subsection 4 (2) of that Act and had effect (under subsection 4 (3) of that Act) as if it had been set out in that Schedule in the place of the first-mentioned table, that other table is taken to have had effect as if that item had been inserted in it.

content.p: (2) Similar amendments to the amendments made by paragraph (1) (a) are taken to have been made to each pathology services table that:

content.p: after 1 August 1986 and before 1 August 1989.
(3) The rules added by paragraph (1) (b) to the pathology services table in Schedule 1a of the Principal Act are taken to have been added:
(a) to each pathology services table that:
(i) was prescribed for the purposes of subsection 4a (2) of the Principal Act; and
(ii) had effect (under subsection 4a (3) of that Act) as if it had been set out in that Schedule;

(b) to the pathology services table that was substituted for the table then in that Schedule by the Community Services and Health Legislation Amendment Act 1989.
(4) The items inserted by paragraph (1) (c) in the pathology services table in Schedule 1a of the Principal Act are taken to have been inserted in each pathology services table that:

item.p: was prescribed for the purposes of subsection 4a (2) of the Principal Act; and
had effect (under subsection 4a (3) of that Act) as if it had been set out in that Schedule;

content.p: after 1 August 1986 and before 1 August 1989.
6. (1) Where:

item.p: before the commencement of this section, a person made a claim for payment of a benefit in respect of a service by reference to an item that, because of the retrospective operation of a provision of section 4 or 5, did not relate to the service; and
the person has been paid in respect of the service a benefit calculated by reference to the fees specified in that item;

content.p: the person is taken to have been entitled to receive in respect of the service the amount of benefit that was paid.
(2) Where:

item.p: before the commencement of this section, a person made a claim for payment of a benefit in respect of a service by reference to an item that, because of the retrospective operation of a provision of section 4 or 5, related to the service; and
the person has been paid in respect of the service a benefit calculated by reference to the fees specified in another item;

content.p: the person is taken to be entitled to receive in respect of the service the higher of:

item.p: the amount of the benefit payable in respect of the service; and
the amount of benefit that was paid.

content.p: (3) Where:

item.p: before the commencement of this section, a person made a claim for payment of a benefit in respect of a service by reference to an item that, because of the retrospective operation of a provision of section 4 or 5, did not relate to the service; and

the person has been paid in respect of the service a benefit calculated by reference to the fees specified in the item that, because of the retrospective operation of a provision of section 4 or 5, related to the service;

content.p: the person is taken to have been entitled to receive in respect of the service the amount of benefit that was paid.
(4) Where:

item.p: before the commencement of this section, a person made a claim for payment of a benefit in respect of a service by reference to an item that, because of the retrospective operation of a provision of section 4 or 5, did not relate to the service; and
subsection (3) does not apply to the person; and
the person has been paid in respect of the service a benefit calculated by reference to the fees specified in another item;

content.p: the person is taken to be entitled to receive the higher of:

item.p: the amount of the benefit payable in respect of the service; and
the amount of benefit that was paid.

content.p: (5) If, apart from this subsection, an amount to which a person is taken to be, or to have been, entitled under this section, would not be an amount payable by the Commonwealth under Part II of the Principal Act, that amount is taken, for the purposes of section 125 of that Act, to be an amount payable by the Commonwealth under that Part.
7. This Act does not affect the liability of any person to pay or repay an amount to the Commonwealth under Part V of the Principal Act.
